messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Thompson <sarah@acme.com>
Cc: David Lin <david.lin@acme.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-26T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Competitive bake-off recap — Acme Corp evaluation

Sarah / David —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our call + proposed next steps so we’re all aligned. Please reply with any corrections.

Key pain points you called out:
- Response latency and inconsistent tail latency for customer-facing chat (esp. peak events).
- Token cost tracking is opaque; team needs per-route cost breakdowns to build accurate forecasts.
- Data residency for logs and audit trails is required for compliance (need VPC/hardened option).

Goals for the evaluation:
1) Demonstrate parity or better latency vs your current provider under a 500 concurrent user synthetic workload.
2) Show per-token cost savings at expected QPS and the effect of caching/batching.
3) Verify audit logging & retention meets your security team’s checklist.

Decision criteria (what you told us):
- Latency SLO: p95 < 250ms for 512-token prompts
- Cost per 1M tokens (normalized)
- Security: SOC2 + VPC + customer-managed KMS
- Integration effort & rollout plan

Bake-off participants we agreed to include:
- Redwood Inference (us)
- Competitor A (current vendor)
- Competitor B (other vendor to compare)

Proposed bake-off plan (timeline):
- Feb 27: We share test harness, routing config, and data sample
- Mar 3–5: Parallel run window (3 days) — Redwood will run hosted evals and provide dedicated test nodes if you want dedicated capacity results
- Mar 6: Results recap and decision sync

Open items for Acme to confirm:
- Which specific production routes should we mirror (list of endpoints)?
- Will procurement provide a PO or SOW template for Dedicated testing if we need it?
- Who on your side will own the security checklist (name/email)?

Attachments: draft bake-off template (redwood-bakeoff-results.pdf) and proposed Method of Play (proposed-mop-v1.xlsx).

Next steps (my asks):
1) Confirm test routes and point person by EOD Feb 27
2) Confirm whether you want dedicated nodes provisioned for the 3-day run
3) Confirm preferred time for results sync the week of Mar 8

Happy to hop on a 15-min call if helpful.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182

We’ll confirm routes and PO/SOW process by EOD Feb 27.

Plan for the three routes Sarah listed:

- /internal-gen: low QPS but requires KMS-protected logs — will need to know if Acme requires customer-managed keys for the hosted run or expects Private deployment.

I’ll prepare two artifact sets: 1) run scripts & harness (for their infra team), 2) a results template that maps to their decision criteria (latency, cost, security).
